decisions.reason: As a very low-cost complementary care product for the installed base of wood floors, it remains worth keeping because downside is limited and its continued presence suggests no strong negative signal requiring abandonment.
The maintenance oil line fits the firm's core flooring-and-aftercare system and can stay on the market while demand learning continues at modest carrying cost.

This care line still merits retention as an option for the oiled-floor niche, but its narrower segment and overlap with adjacent care products make later pruning more plausible than for the broader care items.

The oak parquet line is strategically close to the firm's core capabilities and customer base, yet its higher complexity and carrying costs mean the firm is more likely to rationalise weak variants if traction does not strengthen.
